q: What should I eat before surgery?
a: Follow your surgeon's specific fasting instructions exactly — these are usually strict about timing for safety reasons.

q: How long will I be in hospital?
a: This varies a lot by procedure and how your recovery goes — your surgical team will give you a personalised estimate.

q: When can I shower after surgery?
a: This depends on your wound care instructions — check the specific guidance your care team gave you at discharge.
Most procedures require you to stop driving for a period afterward — your surgeon will confirm when it's safe for your specific case.

q: What should I pack for the hospital?
a: Comfortable loose clothing, essential toiletries, any regular medications in original packaging, and comfortable slip-on shoes are commonly recommended.
